PCA-001.note: One result per selected action in catalogue order; unknown IDs are reported in ignoredSelection and never run.

PCA-003.note: The engine tracks the working media by the last successful transformation; ActionExecutor owns the media and must not touch it on failure.

PCA-005.note: No action failure discards working media; workingMediaRetained is always true.

PCA-006.note: Temporary file creation and cleanup are covered by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.

PCA-007.note: Native PNG saving encodes once into an owner-private temporary file and atomically publishes through Linux RENAME_NOREPLACE. Existing files, dangling symlinks and racing writers are never replaced; collisions retry fresh random names. CaptureActions records the absolute native path, actual media type/byte length and immutable filename-generation context. Independent native tests cover exact pixels, concurrent/racing publication, private permissions, cleanup and value-free failures. Full action artifact/result serialization, durable recovery, configured counter/storage integration, all save variants and native review/target qualification remain Required.

PCA-008.note: Annotation runs before save and a successful result becomes working media. Offering the re-editable document to persistence arrives with the ImageEditor.

PCA-009.note: Selection cancel and replacement are implemented. Persisting a workflow change only on explicit user choice arrives with the selection UI.

PCA-011.note: Retry needs the persisted pipeline result from PCA-012.

PCA-012.note: Durable pipeline results and recovery (interrupted state) arrive with history persistence.

PCA-013.note: The engine emits stable diagnostic codes. Native capture-save encoding, publication and hook exceptions return value-free codes; private file paths and filename context remain artifact data rather than ordinary diagnostics. Complete native action privacy/diagnostic and human review coverage remain Required.

PCA-014.note: One engine, runPipeline(), serves configured workflows, quick actions, and conformance. No UI surface exists yet.

PCA-015.note: No shared state between runs; isolation is covered by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.

PCA-016.note: The adapter emits the canonical result shape with no extension object.

PCA-017.note: The compiled catalogue is checked against actions.json by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.
